title: Treating the Gap Between a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Quote and the Appraisal
content:
The figure the agreement stands at is the amount quoted, or the highest revised offer already put on the agreement where that is higher. How the gap between the figure the agreement stands at and the amount the appraisal supports is treated follows the Renew programme's revision tolerance.

**The two quantities.** The gap is the figure the agreement stands at less the amount the appraisal supports, never below nothing and rounded to the cent. The tolerance is the figure the agreement stands at multiplied by the programme's revision tolerance percentage and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent.

1. Where the amount the appraisal supports falls below the figure the agreement stands at by no more than the programme's revision tolerance, the offer is put at the figure the agreement stands at.
2. Where the amount the appraisal supports falls below the figure the agreement stands at by more than the programme's revision tolerance but by no more than twice that tolerance, the offer is put at the amount the appraisal supports together with the half gap share of the difference to the figure the agreement stands at, being 50 per cent of that difference, and the sum is rounded to the cent.
3. Where the amount the appraisal supports falls below the figure the agreement stands at by more than twice the programme's revision tolerance, the offer is put at the amount the appraisal supports as it stands.

**Both sides of each boundary.** A gap standing at exactly the tolerance is no more than the tolerance, so the first branch governs. A gap one cent above the tolerance is more than it, and the second branch governs until the gap reaches exactly twice the tolerance, which is still no more than twice it. A gap one cent above twice the tolerance is more than twice it, and the third branch governs.

**Worked comparison on hypothetical inputs.** Take an agreement standing at 2000.00 USD on a programme whose revision tolerance is 10 per cent, so the tolerance is 200.00 USD and twice the tolerance is 400.00 USD.

| Amount the appraisal supports | The gap | The offer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1850.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 2000.00 USD |
| 1800.00 USD | 200.00 USD | 2000.00 USD |
| 1700.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 1850.00 USD |
| 1600.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 1800.00 USD |
| 1500.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 1500.00 USD |

In the third row the offer is 1700.00 USD together with 50 per cent of the 300.00 USD difference, which is 150.00 USD, giving 1850.00 USD. Where the appraisal supports more than the figure the agreement stands at, the gap is nothing, which is no more than the tolerance, and the offer is put at the figure the agreement stands at.
